selection_rule.description: Select exactly the first two records of the source 96-image manifest's 'records' array in ascending selection_rank order, requiring partition == 'discovery' for both. The source manifest's own records are already persisted in ascending selection_rank order (0..95); this authority does not re-sort them, and re-sorting by selection_key or canonical_image_id is explicitly prohibited by this rule.
selection_rule.sort_key: selection_rank (ascending, as already persisted in the source manifest; not re-derived)

canonical_record_encoding.definition: For the ordered list of selected canonical_image_id strings (list order is meaningful and part of the digest, equal to selected_ranks order), the digest is SHA256 of the concatenation, in list order, of each id's ASCII bytes followed by a single 0x0A (newline) byte. hexdigest() output, lowercase.
